title: [feature request] add displays-off to the super-P quick options
line: The Meta+P screen layout popup now has a "Turn off screens" option; any key press or mouse movement turns the screens back on.
explanation: The Meta+P selector (kscreen_osd_service) only offered layout presets, so turning every screen off needed the separate Turn Off Screen shortcut or a command. A new TurnOffScreens OSD action, placed before "Leave unchanged", switches all outputs to DPMS off through libkscreen's Dpms (the mechanism powerdevil's Turn Off Screen uses) and closes the popup; KWin turns the screens back on at the next input, which gives the revert-on-input the reporter asked for. The applet's screen layout list filters the new action out, since it isn't a layout.

commits.message:
osd: add an option to turn off all screens

The Meta+P selector had no way to turn every screen off while leaving
the computer running. Add a "Turn off screens" option that uses DPMS
like the Turn Off Screen shortcut, so any input turns them back on.

BUG: 524906

media.caption: Meta+P popup on master: only layout presets and Leave unchanged
With the change: a "Turn off screens" option (power icon) before Leave unchanged

review.text: A small, self-contained OSD action using libkscreen's Dpms, the same mechanism powerdevil uses (powerdevil has no D-Bus method to call instead). It is correctly kept out of the applet's layout list, and applyAction returns no job for it. Minor points: it doesn't honour powerdevil's lock-before-turn-off setting, and system-shutdown may read as 'shut down the computer', so the VDG may want another icon.
